stages.desc: One of 10 3-Stages in Illinois to undergo Concept Unification. Last 3-Stage in Illinois from  2020 until November 2020. Was in Good Condition. 3-Stage animatronics replaced with the Studio C animatronic from the now closed Lafayette, Indiana store, with the stage becoming the second CU Beta 16M installed.
Last CU Beta 16m in a location.
